invariants.rationale: A valid HoodieTable object is expected to be returned by the factory method.
config is an input parameter and the table cannot be created without it.
metaClient is an input parameter and needed for HoodieTable creation.
A valid HoodieTable should have an associated non-null HoodieTableMetaClient.
The HoodieTable returned should be associated with the same metaClient that was passed in.
